resources.string: Back up labels, favourites, album and label groups, illustrations and expansion states. Photos and videos are not included.
Label links match file contents; album groups restore by their original folder paths. Group illustrations and expansion states are included, but photos and videos are not.
Adds missing labels, groups and memberships without moving existing members. Album groups use original folder paths; unmatched media links are skipped.
Could not read %1$d local files. Check file access and scan again.
The export skipped %1$d unavailable files; their links are not in this backup.
Copy the original files, allow access, then import again. Edited or compressed copies require labels to be assigned manually.
These files were not labelled automatically. Keep the original filenames or album paths when copying, then import again, or assign their labels manually.

Import could not finish. Check access and the backup, then retry. Restored entries are kept; retrying does not duplicate them.
